title: Task 2 R1 — falsify one genuinely new native-provider first-known source chain
question: Given newly authenticated, original, per-field provider publication/response vintage evidence for an entire preregistered source family, independently try to falsify its first-known before issued forecast clock, any provider-revision or CFGI engine-era inference, 11-attempt source dependency, and resulting R1 information-only partial-cohort eligibility. Does the new evidence genuinely change R1 admission vs previous Sol result, or is the added proof insufficient? Do not estimate portfolio edge.
hypothesis: A genuinely independent original provider response/vintage receipt bound to an original issued forecast, including revision and custody timestamps, can support one narrow R1 source-family decision without relying on Git commit time, provider backfill retrieval or later outcomes. It can be falsified by clock mismatch, capture provenance gap, duplicate exposure, selection on outcome, source-version mismatch or missing negative opportunities.
baseline: Original Sol mission TASK2-R1-CFGI-PIT-FALSIFICATION-002 concluded VERDICT=INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE on 2026-10-14, receipt estimated cost 0.438430 USD. Cheap deterministic Git blob/census/collector timestamp equality checks plus packet-price-sign observational baseline do not establish provider publication time or independent predictive edge.
falsifier: Any original provider first-publication/revision/response time is after issue, not independently bound, or is substituted by settlement time/late query, or source/issued/outcome version mismatch; the newly claimed independent family has overlapping forecasts or missing abstentions/no-issue opportunities; retrospective outcome choice drove the cohort; or effective first-known lacks a bound underlying payload (private value-free SHA receipt acceptable only with authorized private verification).
kill_condition: If there is NO MATERIAL NEW original source-vintage evidence compared with the already-completed Sol R1 receipt, do not release this mission, do not trigger GPT-6.1 Sol, and return QUEUE_HOLD_NO_NEW_PROOF. If data exists but is restricted, only use authorized cross-repository exact immutable bindings; otherwise mark PRIVATE_DATA_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE. If R1 remains unadmitted, do not simulate historical R2+ or change rules.

eligible_if: An authenticated independent original provider publication/response/vintage receipt, bound by exact immutable timestamp, source contract, Git commit/path/blob/hash, and issuance clock is committed or reviewed by the existing Task 2 #1596 source owner
Source-specific information existed by original issue, without relying on a later API or 2025 backfill retrieved in 2026
All original attempts (including abstain/absent) in selected source-family cohort and duplicate source packet/event clusters are enumerated without outcome-aware selection
Exact source evidence not used in the already completed prior Sol R1 analysis is available

prohibited: Repeat already executed Sol R1 source-clock report unchanged
Original provider first-known fabricated from Git / retrieval / settlement timestamps
Historical outcome edit, scoring, experiment promotion
Private provider raw values on public control plane
New workflow, queue, model router, budget or paid data source
Any Sol self-approval, code write, auto-merge, permission escalation
next_allowed_action: After exact new provider-first-known evidence + nonauthoring owner review + budget/reserve check, change old active mission to held and this exact mission to ACTIVE_RELEASED through a governed branch/PR, keeping max_active_missions=1. Then, and only then, use owner-approved [RESEARCH_LAB_SOL] mission=TASK2-R1-FIRST-KNOWN-INCREMENTAL-003 trigger on issue 1476 and record actual gateway receipt.
